ayahs.4: Aur raat ki jab woh chalne lage.
ayahs.5: Kya in mein aqalmand ke waaste kaafi qasam hai.
ayahs.6: Kya aap ne nahin dekha ke aap ke Rabb ne Aadiyon ke saath kya kiya.
ayahs.8: Jis ki maanind (koi qaum) mulkon mein paida nahin ki gayi.
ayahs.9: Aur Samoodiyon ke saath jinhon ne waadi mein bade bade patthar taraashe the.
ayahs.10: Aur Firaun ke saath jo meikhon wala tha.
ayahs.11: In sabhon ne shehron mein sar utha rakha tha.
ayahs.12: Aur bahut fasaad macha rakha tha.
ayahs.13: Aakhir tere Rabb ne un sab par azaab ka koda barsaya.
ayahs.14: Yaqeenan tera Rabb ghaat mein hai.
ayahs.15: Insaan (ka yeh haal hai ke) jab use us ka Rabb aazmaata hai aur izzat-o-naimat deta hai to woh kehne lagta hai ke mere Rabb ne mujhe izzat-daar banaya.
ayahs.16: Aur jab woh us ko aazmaata hai us ki rozi tang kar deta hai to woh kehne lagta hai ke mere Rabb ne meri ihaanat ki (aur zaleel kiya).
ayahs.17: Aisa hargiz nahin, balke (baat yeh hai) ke tum (hi) log yateemon ki izzat nahin karte.
ayahs.18: Aur miskeenon ke khilaane ki ek doosre ko targheeb nahin dete.
ayahs.19: Aur (murdon ki) meeraas sameit sameit kar khaate ho.
ayahs.20: Aur maal ko ji bhar kar azeez rakhte ho.
ayahs.21: Yaqeenan jis waqt zameen koot koot kar baraabar kar di jaayegi.
ayahs.22: Aur tera Rabb (khud) aa jaayega aur farishte saffen baandh kar (aa jaaenge).
ayahs.23: Aur jis din jahannam bhi laai jaayegi, us din insaan ko samajh aayegi, magar aaj is ke samajhne ka faayda kahan?
ayahs.24: Woh kahega ke kaash ke main ne apni is zindagi ke liye kuchh peshgi saamaan kiya hota.
ayahs.25: Pas aaj Allah ke azaab jaisa azaab kisi ka na hoga.
ayahs.26: Na us ki qaid-o-band jaisi kisi ki qaid-o-band hogi.
ayahs.28: Tu apne Rabb ki taraf laut chal is tarah ke tu us se raazi, woh tujh se khush.
ayahs.29: Pas mere khaas bandon mein daakhil ho ja.
ayahs.30: Aur meri jannat mein chali ja.
